_README: PLACEHOLDER CASES, NOT REAL LABELS. These exist so the labelling -> export -> gate pipeline can be built and proven end to end BEFORE any hand-labelling happens, which is what makes Teja's ~20 real labels pure data entry rather than a build task. The `placeholder` flag above is read by the gate, which then refuses to report a green run as meaningful: a gate that proves nothing while looking exactly like a gate that proves everything is the most dangerous state available here. Running `_shared/eval/export.ts` against a populated `matcher_eval_cases` overwrites this file with real cases and sets `placeholder` to false. Do not hand-edit labels here - the database is the labelling surface and this file is its export, so an edit made here is lost on the next export.
